_: The app's own English for antiphons and responsories of the Ordo Cantus Officii that are not the Liturgia Horarum's (where iBreviary's English would translate another text), in the style of iBreviary's (ICEL) English. Keys: the Latin as ownKey() in site/translate.js makes it (lower case, no accents or punctuation, j as i, ae and oe for æ and œ); a responsory's versicle follows on a new line (\n). scripts/texts/missing_translations.cjs lists the texts of the window still without one.
